passed: the three identities and their black suit, cobalt jacket, and cream dress remain recognizable

deviation: future subjects become visible before the preceding foreground occlusion is complete

diagnosis.conclusion: Prompt design contributed materially, but the template format alone is not the root cause.
primary_causes: task overload: three complete orbits, two occlusion transitions, and a final group composition were requested inside fifteen seconds
the prompt did not quantify occluder frame coverage or the exact moment when the next subject may become visible
the three subjects had no explicit room coordinates or one-direction camera route
diagnosis.model_boundary: Maintaining three referenced identities, one environment, a continuous camera path, and two precise occlusion reveals is intrinsically difficult and still requires repeated tests after prompt optimization.
diagnosis.recommended_next_test: Use three short approximately ninety-degree arcs, require at least ninety percent frame coverage at each transition, keep future subjects fully off-screen until their reveal point, and reserve the final four seconds for the pullback group composition.
